title: Overpartition congruences and class-restricted towers
description: Unrefereed computer-assisted proof collection: Wei congruences modulo 7, 17, 19 and 23; class-restricted square-prime towers modulo 13, 17 and 23; and an exact modulo-13 whole-class classification. Contains three revised papers, exact finite modular-form certificates, explicit overlap and prior-art attribution, and failure-sensitive verification. Universal claims depend on the written modularity and Sturm arguments, not finite testing alone. No formal verification, external peer review, independent reproduction or four-star significance is asserted.
